words.gloss: at the time of yielding results

literal: Do not desire coveting-obtained wealth; at the time of yielding results, for being excellent rare will be the fruit.
translation: Do not desire the wealth acquired by coveting others' goods; for when it yields its final results, its fruit will be devoid of any goodness.
modern: பிறர் பொருளைக் கவர்ந்து பெறும் செல்வத்தை விரும்பாதீர்; அது தன் பயனைத் தரும் போது, அதன் விளைவு நன்மையாக இருக்காது.
explanation: This couplet warns against seeking wealth through covetousness. The phrase 'வெஃகி ஆம் ஆக்கம்' refers to wealth acquired by desiring and taking what belongs to others. Although such wealth might seem beneficial at first, the poet warns that 'விளைவயின்' (at the time of yielding its ultimate consequences), the actual benefit or 'பயன்' will be 'மாண்டற்கு அரிது' (extremely rare to have any goodness or dignity). In short, ill-gotten gains bring only ruin and misery in the end.
